Subject: MAP Draft — Security review & SOC 2 package delivery

Hi Sofia / Liam,

Quick post-call recap and the first draft of the MAP attached (MAP-Aurelia-v1.xlsx). Thanks for taking the time today — good alignment on use case and procurement cadence.

High-level MAP milestone we discussed: Security review + SOC 2 package delivery. Proposed milestones and responsibilities below (please confirm):

- Target close date: 2026-08-31 (proposal; can adjust based on procurement)
- Milestone: Security review & SOC 2 package delivery
  - Redwood (Marissa / Marcus): Deliver SOC 2 package (questionnaire, evidence manifest, sample logs, architecture diagram) by 2026-08-12 EOD PT
  - Aurelia Security (Sofia / security@aureliatech.com): Review package and confirm any follow-ups by 2026-08-20
  - Dependencies: Legal/Procurement PO, any additional compliance questionnaire items from Aurelia, auditor/scoped access if needed

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the dates above or propose alternatives.
2) Marcus will gather the technical evidence items we called out.
3) I’ll upload the SOC 2 package by next Wednesday (8/12) and update the MAP with final dates and owner assignments.

Attachments: MAP-Aurelia-v1.xlsx (draft MAP)

If that looks good, I’ll finalize the MAP and deliver the SOC 2 bundle next week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0191

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform

From: Sofia Rivera <sofia@aureliatech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@aureliatech.com>, Aurelia Tech Security <security@aureliatech.com>
Date: 2026-08-06T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Draft — Security review & SOC 2 package delivery

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear MAP. A few quick items from our side: 

- Timeline: Procurement is aiming to have PO finalized by 2026-08-20, so your proposed dates look OK as long as we get the SOC 2 package by 8/12 as you suggested.
- For the security review, our security team will need:
  * The completed SOC 2 questionnaire (if you have an editable PDF that’s preferred)
  * An evidence manifest (CSV or spreadsheet) that maps controls to artifacts
  * Architecture diagram and list of data flows (PII handling, retention, encryption)

Can you confirm whether the package will include sample logs and a contact for engineering access if we need to validate any evidence? Also, please call out any items that would require additional work (e.g., longer log retention, custom encryption requirements) so we can flag with procurement.

I’m looping in Liam (procurement) and our security alias. We’ll plan to schedule a short security review meeting after we receive the package.

Thanks,
Sofia Rivera
Head of IT Security | Aurelia Tech
sofia@aureliatech.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Rivera <sofia@aureliatech.com>; Liam Chen <liam.chen@aureliatech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Aurelia Tech Security <security@aureliatech.com>
Date: 2026-08-07T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Draft — Security review & SOC 2 package delivery

Thanks Sofia — great questions. We’ll include everything you listed. Quick confirmation of deliverables and owners below and I’ve attached the SOC 2 questionnaire and evidence manifest for your review.

Deliverables (Redwood):
- redwood-soc2-questionnaire.pdf (completed) — attached
- soc2-evidence-manifest.csv (mapping of controls to artifacts) — attached
- architecture_diagram_v1.pdf (high level data flows) — included in package zip
- sample logs (redacted) and instructions for time-limited access to auditor logs — included in zip

Owners & Dates: 
- Redwood (Marissa): Deliver full SOC 2 package (redwood-soc2-package-20260812.zip) by 2026-08-12 EOD PT
- Redwood (Marcus): Provide collected evidence artifacts and temporary access details by 2026-08-10
- Aurelia Security (Sofia): Schedule security review meeting — suggested window 2026-08-13 to 2026-08-14
- Aurelia Procurement (Liam): Confirm PO by 2026-08-20

Dependencies we flagged: any additional questionnaire items you add back; confirmation on whether the auditor will need direct access or just the package; agreement on retention windows. If anything will take longer than the dates above I’ll surface it immediately.

Related links: https://hubspot.redwoodinference.com/deal/12345 (MAP & deal)

Attachments included in the package: redwood-soc2-package-20260812.zip (contains redwood-soc2-questionnaire.pdf, soc2-evidence-manifest.csv, architecture_diagram_v1.pdf, sample_logs_redacted/), redwood-soc2-questionnaire.pdf, soc2-evidence-manifest.csv

If that works, I’ll upload the zip to the Drive and send a follow-up when it’s available.

Best,
Marissa

- Follow-up: confirm retention windows for logs older than 90 days (we may ask for longer retention as an add-on)
- Action: procurement to confirm PO by 2026-08-20

We'll update the MAP with the review notes and next milestone. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
